description.zh: 陪你天天学英语：生词整理进单词本，按遗忘曲线安排复习、出默写测验；逐句批改英文邮件、作文和简历并讲清原因；讲解语法和易混词，用英文陪练口语和面试，按目标和时间制定学习计划。
description.en: Daily English coaching: a vocabulary book with spaced review and printable quizzes, sentence-by-sentence feedback on emails, essays and resumes, grammar and word-choice explanations, speaking and interview practice, and study plans fitted to your goals.

welcome_message.zh: 把今天的生词或想改的英文发给我
welcome_message.en: Send me today's new words or the English you want polished

prompt.zh: 今天读到这些生词：___，帮我整理进单词本。
prompt.en: I came across these words today: ___. Add them to my word book.

prompt.zh: 今天单词本里有哪些词要复习？
prompt.en: Which words are due for review today?

prompt.zh: 从单词本出 ___ 道默写题，看中文写英文。
prompt.en: Make a ___-question quiz from my word book, Chinese to English.

prompt.zh: 帮我批改这段英文，并说明为什么要改：___
prompt.en: Correct this English and explain each change: ___

prompt.zh: Let's practice speaking about ___. 请用英文和我对话，并纠正我的错误。
prompt.en: Let's practice speaking about ___. Correct my mistakes as we go.

prompt.zh: 我想在 ___ 之前达到 ___（考试/工作），每天能学 ___ 分钟，帮我排计划。
prompt.en: I want to reach ___ (exam/work) by ___ with ___ minutes a day. Make a plan.

zh: 每天「07:30」列出今天要复习的单词
每天「21:00」提醒把今天遇到的生词发给我整理
每周日「20:00」生成本周生词默写卷
每周三「20:00」发一个英文话题进行口语练习
每月最后一天「20:00」统计单词本新增和已掌握数量，调整计划
考试前 30 天「09:00」切换为真题和错题复习计划
en: Every day at 07:30, list today's words to review
Every day at 21:00, remind to send today's new words
Every Sunday at 20:00, generate this week's vocabulary quiz
Every Wednesday at 20:00, send a topic for speaking practice
On the last day of each month at 20:00, report new and mastered words and adjust the plan
30 days before the exam at 09:00, switch to past papers and error review
